title: Parsing Input with ParseStrategy
hints: A currency format style has a `parseStrategy` that reads `$1,234.50`.
Fall back to `Decimal(string:locale:)` for plain numbers.
Multiply by 100 and round a `Decimal` with `NSDecimalRound`.
jsBridge: Format styles also **parse** user input (`parseStrategy`), turning "$1,234.50" into a `Decimal`. JS has no built-in locale-aware parsing (`Intl` only formats), so apps hand-roll regexes.

compass.q: How do you parse "1.234,50 €" in JS? Why is that a notorious gap?
